Xbox Live for the original Xbox was shut down in 2010. Insignia is a free, fan-run service that brings it back — online matches, friends and leaderboards in the games that supported them.\n\nIt takes about five minutes to set up. You only have to do this once.

Turns on networking and points your console at Insignia\'s servers. Nothing to choose — just tap it.\n\nYour console also needs the final Xbox dashboard (version D:1.00.5960.01). On an older dashboard the steps below all appear to work, but signing in from a game will fail.
Download Insignia-Setup.iso from the Setup Assistant download page. Pick it below, boot it, then press Register.
Could not start the Setup Assistant.

Enter your email on insignia.live to get a code. Then boot the dashboard, choose Xbox Live, and sign up.\n\nWhen it asks for card details, use 4111 1111 1111 1111 — Insignia does not collect them. Use the same email you requested the code with.

Xanite is an emulator frontend for running Xbox original software on Android.\n\nXaniteOG is an open-source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft in any way. This project is intended for educational and research purposes as we continue developing and porting the emulator to Android.

We do not condone piracy. BIOS files and game backups must be legally owned. While emulator software itself is legal, downloading or distributing copyrighted BIOS files or games without ownership is illegal. Please be responsible and cautious online.

XaniteOG processes BIOS, HDD, game images, controller input, preferences, and diagnostic logs on your device. User-selected game and firmware files are not uploaded by the app.

The optional cover-art feature connects to the configured GitHub cover repository; that service can receive normal connection information such as your IP address. Xanite Gold activation signs you in with Patreon and sends your Patreon account identifier and a device identifier derived from this device to the Xanite activation backend. The backend uses them only to confirm your purchase and to manage your device slots; it stores your Patreon user ID and the device identifiers bound to it. Signing in with Patreon does not give the app access to your payment details.

Crash and session logs remain in app-private storage unless you explicitly copy or export them. System Link can exchange a nickname, lobby information, network addresses, and gameplay traffic with hosts or peers you choose. Passwords entered for private lobbies are used for that connection and should not be retained beyond the session.

Local data remains until you clear it or uninstall the app. Unbinding a device removes its identifier from the activation backend. For privacy questions or deletion requests concerning server-side records, use the developer contact shown on the Xanite Patreon page.
